modelDecisions: Preserve the characteristic three broad V chamfers. The real crown projects above a lower mechanical roof; closing it as a flat 257.2 m triangle would change the building.

A triangulated opaque mechanical roof, opaque inner crown lining, and rim faces close the previous one-sided appearance. The physical 0.18 m cladding offset is a rendering construction, not a measured assembly thickness.
Rotunda facade members follow exposed mapped wall segments. Balcony slabs are inset from the same perimeter so independent circular rings cannot protrude through adjoining volumes.
Auditorium exterior is a simplified leaning glass enclosure inside the mapped outline. The timber room, balcony spacing, roof framing and service plant are illustrative details.
The six local occupied-volume masks are shared with generic city-shell generation. Elevated skybridge clearance is kept separate from ground driving collision.
uncertainties: Sources count floors differently: the architect describes six rotunda stories and five podium stories; the structural engineer describes seven and six levels. The tower is commonly described as 50 stories while CVU counts 52 above-ground floors including qualifying mechanical/mezzanine floors.
Thornton Tomasetti rounds tower height to 850 ft; the model uses CVU architectural height of 257.2 m.
Public auditorium plans and sections were located and viewed. A complete openly licensed tower construction or as-built blueprint set was not located.
OSM footprint positions, crown taper, glazing, floor spacing and connections are not survey-grade. No hidden structural system or exact plant layout is claimed.
